deviation: The "breach of law" indemnity is narrowed to breach of Article 7, so it covers only the legal obligations Article 7 lists and not Vertex's breach of law generally. The playbook makes this indemnity mandatory and its fallback only allows excluding gross negligence. The draft also adds a reciprocal Arcadia indemnity (9.2) for materials or data that violate law or third-party rights, which the standard doesn't include and which gives Arcadia new exposure.
suggested_text: 9.1 Vertex shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Arcadia, its Affiliates and their personnel from third-party claims, and resulting losses, damages, costs and reasonable attorneys' fees, arising from (a) an allegation that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate a third party's intellectual property rights; (b) Vertex's breach of applicable law (including, without limitation, its obligations under Article 7); or (c) Vertex's gross negligence or willful misconduct. 9.2 [Delete. If Vertex insists on a reciprocal indemnity, limit it to third-party claims that Arcadia's materials, as provided by Arcadia and used by Vertex in accordance with this Agreement, infringe third-party intellectual property rights, and make it subject to the limitation of liability.] 9.3 The indemnified Party shall give prompt written notice of the claim, allow the indemnifying Party to control the defense and settlement (provided no settlement may impose liability or admissions on the indemnified Party without its consent), and provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying Party's expense.
